title: This Ice Cube Tray Is Trickier Than It Looks
text: This Ice Cube Tray Is Trickier Than It Looks. Hmm, I'm not sure what I'm doing wrong but I don't get little round balls. Instead, I get just half a ball, as though the ice ball had been sliced in half. The lid also isn't easy release for me. I have to work hard to pry the two pieces apart after freezing. Though that may be because I'm old enough to have lost a lot of my physical strength. In any event, this ice cube tray doesn't work well for me. If you try it, hopefully you will have better luck than I did.
